svg.title: Day 2 hero: a podcast studio microphone stands on a round stage, sending out soft sound waves, with a playing waveform above it. On the left, a cause-and-effect chain rises: a laptop and phone (cause) feed a stack of servers, which puff out a CO₂ cloud (effect). On the right, three source cards — Griffiths (2020), UNCTAD (2024) and a UN podcast — are linked by the words “similarly” and “whereas”.
